typography_participation_modes.instruction_en: Generate a clean editorial base image without actual readable typography. Reserve intended negative-space regions for later SVG or HTML overlays. Do not generate random letters, fake captions, logos, watermarks, or poster copy.
Compose the subject, prop direction, clean silhouette, and negative space for later typography masking or layout. Do not render accurate readable text in the image.
Allow only one very short decorative word, number, seal-like mark, or texture-like letterform. Treat it as a visual accent, never as reliable text rendering.

single_portrait_gaze_locks.instruction_en: Lock both eyes clearly onto the lens center. Keep eye focus aligned and intentional.

typography_interaction_presets.rule_en: Keep typography on outer margins, top bands, bottom bands, or sidebars. Do not cross the face.
A large masthead may overlap background or hair tips only. Never cover eyes, brows, nose bridge, or mouth.
Reserve a large title field behind the clean subject silhouette for later SVG or HTML masking.
Wrap typography around the silhouette edge without crossing face, neck, or active hands.
Use graphic frames or minimal type around the face only; keep the facial recognition region unobstructed.
Align later typography with a readable prop direction such as board, microphone, menu, or fabric trail.
Reserve space for sticker, ASCII, card, or support-image overlays. Add them in post-production.
Allow typography to cross clothing only. Never cross face, neck, or active hands.
Allow dense side columns and bottom bands while keeping the face and active hands clean.
Allow the masthead to touch hair edge or background silhouette only. Preserve the eyes, nose bridge, and mouth.
When the environment already contains signage, reduce additional overlays and preserve breathing room.
Keep captions away from active hands and props such as food, straps, menus, headphones, and microphones.
Wrap later typography around the running silhouette without crossing neck, face, active arms, or forward leg.
Reserve one hero panel and one or two support panels for later SVG or HTML composition.
Reserve clean rectangular bands for post-production label strips. Do not generate readable label text in-image.
